name: Elemera Garwie
source:
A female archer from the Northern Barbarians who attempts to assassinate Ashley on Vols' orders.

Even among the Northern Barbarians who excel at forest combat, she excels in stealth techniques and is often assigned espionage and assassination missions.

She is a rare rebellious character among the barbarians, who tend to be male chauvinists, and because she is not only strong-willed but also skilled, the men in the tribes accept her as a member of their fighting groups (setting aside emotional issues).
